h4.b: Click ">" in the first column of any row below to see your team's submission history for that question.

search.query: | inputlookup ctf_questions | search ctf_id="$ctf_id$" | fields ctf_id Number Question BasePoints | eval Attempts=0, IncorrectAttempts=0, CorrectAttempts=0, BasePointsEarned=0, BonusPointsEarned=0, AdditionalBonus=0, PenaltyPoints=0 | append [ search index=scoreboard ctf_id="$ctf_id$" Team="$ctf_Team$" (Result="Incorrect" OR Result="Correct" OR Result="Bonus") | stats count as Attempts max(BasePointsAwarded) as BasePointsEarned max(SpeedBonusAwarded) as BonusPointsEarned sum(Penalty) as PenaltyPoints max(AdditionalBonusAwarded) as AdditionalBonus count(eval(Result=="Incorrect")) as IncorrectAttempts count(eval(Result=="Correct")) as CorrectAttempts by ctf_id Number ] | stats last(Question) as Question max(BasePoints) as BasePointsAvailable max(BasePointsEarned) as BasePointsEarned max(BonusPointsEarned) as BonusPointsEarned max(AdditionalBonus) as AdditionalBonus sum(PenaltyPoints) as PenaltyPoints sum(Attempts) as Attempts sum(IncorrectAttempts) as IncorrectAttempts sum(CorrectAttempts) as CorrectAttempts by ctf_id Number | eval Status=case( CorrectAttempts>0, "Correct", IncorrectAttempts>0, "Incorrect", true(), "Unanswered" ) | fillnull value=0 BasePointsEarned BonusPointsEarned PenaltyPoints AdditionalBonus | fields ctf_id Number Question Status BasePointsAvailable BasePointsEarned BonusPointsEarned AdditionalBonus PenaltyPoints | rename BasePointsAvailable as "Base Points Avail." BasePointsEarned as "Base Points Earned" BonusPointsEarned as "Speed Bonus Earned" PenaltyPoints as "Penalty" AdditionalBonus as "Additional Bonus" | sort 0 + Number
